title: Infrastructure Tracker
description: Executes OpenCTI infrastructure hunts on internet scanning data. An infrastructure hunt lists the fingerprints of adversary infrastructure (JARM, JA4X, JA4S, certificate fingerprint, subject or issuer, HTTP title, body hash or Server header, banner hash, ASN) as a native query for the internet hunt platform. For every hunt run, the connector searches them on the configured sources (Censys Platform, Silent Push, urlscan.io, Team Cymru Scout), enriches the IP addresses found with Shodan InternetDB, and creates in OpenCTI an infrastructure consisting of the public IPv4 addresses, domain names and X.509 certificates found, each with a detection indicator, related to and indicated as the threats the hunt targets, plus one observed-data per observable with the number of hosts holding it, stamped with the hunt run. All objects inherit the markings and the author of the hunt; OpenCTI receives the hit count, the per-source queries run and a hashed, truncated evidence sample of the fingerprints matched. Before you start: an API key per internet scanning source (Censys Platform, Silent Push, urlscan.io, Team Cymru Scout) with search access. The least-privilege permissions, the console steps and a copy-ready configuration are at https://docs.opencti.io/latest/usage/hunt-connectors/#infrastructure-tracker, and Test connection on the connector page in OpenCTI checks them.
short_description: Tracks adversary infrastructure fingerprints (JARM, JA4X, certificates, HTTP banners, ASN) on Censys, Silent Push, urlscan.io, Team Cymru Scout and Shodan InternetDB for OpenCTI infrastructure hunts.
